headers.comment: Baseline: anything not matched by a LATER, more specific rule below resolves to index.html via the SPA rewrite above, and must NOT be cached. Firebase Hosting's default (max-age=3600) let a visitor hold an index.html referencing chunk hashes from a previous build; once those chunks are gone the rewrite serves index.html as text/html, the module import fails strict MIME checking, and the app never boots — a blank page for up to an hour after every deploy. Order matters: when several entries match, the LAST one wins (verified against the deployed site, not assumed), so this broad rule must come first.
Angular emits content-hashed filenames (main-QAOTS2KA.js), so a given URL's bytes never change — cache them hard. Last match wins, so this overrides the baseline above.
